summary_text: On this weekend, a single unit of Dot & Key Vitamin C + E Super Bright Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ (30 g) was purchased during the evening. This timing aligns with the population baseline, where evening purchases (0.3027) are nearly as common as morning purchases (0.3246). The product is a face sunscreen with brightening claims, typically used for daily UV protection and cosmetic finish. This is a single observation from one date; it is not yet established whether this brand or product type represents a stable preference or a one-time need.
